name: Default
shortDescription: Browser-based password manager that opens and edits KeePass (.kdbx) databases, served as a static web app by nginx.

alerts.message: Vaults are not stored on the server. Keep your .kdbx file in browser storage, on a WebDAV server, or on Dropbox, Google Drive or OneDrive after registering your own app keys for this domain.
This image runs on x86_64 servers only.
